scope: Opening silent hero shots only; user authorized ongoing rendering. No later-film/native-plate render performed here.

notebook.I_start_state: cricket spread already revealed; place after H dense-cricket insert, not directly after F covered end-state

performance: Small retained-geometry key-pose snaps bracketed by continuous torso/hand/pen movement, not lip sync. Restrained original neutral/crooked mouth rather than the V2 broad laugh.
limitations: Lower seated anatomy is desk-occluded; no full seated-rig audit.
2.5D hand/page contact is not simulated 3D paper physics.
